question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank and complete the sentence.

The water was too ________ (profound) to take a swim.
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (1) i.e.** 'Shallow'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Profound** means the deepest part of something.**(गहरा)**

 
 
• **Example:- **His knowledge of history is** profound.**
 
 
 
• The word** Shallow **means not very deep, upper part of something.**(छिछला)**
 
 
• **Example:- **Serve the noodles in a **shallow** bowl.
 
 
 
• As both the words **Profound and Shallow **are opposite in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options are: 
 
 
• **Dangerous- **able or likely to cause harm or injury.**(ख़तरनाक)**
 
• **Hot- **having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.**(गर्म)**
 
• **Turbid- **opaque, or thick with suspended matter.**(सिथिल)**
